verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs claim user permission management and access control lists, and mention managing repository collaborators. They do not say at which levels these permissions can be set. Missing for 10: documented organization/team-level permissions, project-level permissions, branch protection or branch-level permissions, environment-level permissions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how granular the controls are.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can assign granular permissions at organization, project, repository, branch, and environment level

citations.quote: offering features such as user permission management, access control lists, and more to ensure the security of code and data
